responsibility: Defines the rs6000 subtarget policy for AIX 5.2. In addition to the usual AIX 32/64-bit and PowerPC64 override logic, it handles the soft-float versus long-double-128 incompatibility, updates assembler CPU mappings and default processors to POWER4, publishes _AIX43/_AIX51/_AIX52 preprocessor builtins, supplies AIX 5.2 library/link/startfile specs and ABI type choices, and records small release-specific details such as the atoll declaration and use of the aix64 option table.
